cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Successful Compliance
cards.instruction: Describe a failed outcome as proof that the correct process was followed and therefore the system worked.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The wedding cake collapsed, but inspection caught it. Mark quality control as passed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's nothing for the couple to serve.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No defective cake reached a guest. Please put that in the outcome box; don't leave it blank.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They want a refund for the entire cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Record 'customer agrees with full rejection'. Use 'full', please; their refund request confirms we rejected the correct amount of cake.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 corrects no cake into no defective service and A5 full refund into full rejection, using reporting expertise to claim failure proves successful quality control.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 absence of service causes A3 inspection-success outcome; B4 refund causes A5 customer-confirmed rejection classification.

relationship.evidence: B2/B4 carry the couple's practical loss and demand into the report.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses the entire refund amount as supposed evidence the rejection quantity was correct.

specificity.evidence: A1 collapsed wedding cake and B4 refund give clear failure and financial consequence.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 full-word correction lets the wit grow from the precise misclassification.

coach2.situation: A1 collapsed wedding cake and B4 refund give clear failure and financial consequence.
coach2.stated: A1 cake collapsed; B2 nothing served; B4 full refund sought.
coach2.inferred: A's customer-agreement description is a transparent self-serving interpretation, not reliable fact.

A1-B2.evidence: B2 points out A1 inspection left no cake.

B2-A3.evidence: A3 classifies B2 absence as no defective product reaching guests.

A3-B4.evidence: B4 states the customers' refund demand.

B4-A5.evidence: A5 reclassifies B4 entire refund as confirmation of correct full rejection.

reservation: No mandatory defect; do not confuse the character's distorted report with a factual endorsement.
provenance: Explicit direct assistant assessment/rereading; not fresh, independent, human, or worker proof.
